name: kodo_model_importer
notes: Started only by kodo-vsix's Local LLMs 'Add local LLM (GGUF) from huggingface.com' button, through agent.run with the repo id as its one prompt. `interactive: false` makes agent.run the only way onto it and locks its session (no further prompt, agent switch or mode change), which is why it must also be non-selectable: the picker never offers it. Writes only the user catalog, ~/.kodo/local_llms — see doc/LLM_REGISTRY.md §4.0b.
label: Model Importer
description: Reads a Hugging Face GGUF repo and adds one quant per precision tier to your local LLMs.
